subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Others found it difficult at first but slept better by the end.”?
options: The class discussed why the box was useful.
They discussed why companies might design products that are hard to repair.
The class discussed why phones were hard to put down.
In business class, students discussed convenience and hidden costs.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The class discussed why the box was useful.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They discussed why companies might design products that are hard to repair.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Others found it difficult at first but slept better by the end. The class discussed why phones were hard to put down.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「In business class, students discussed convenience and hidden costs.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Others found it difficult at first but slept better by the end. The class discussed why phones were hard to put down.」，答案為「The class discussed why phones were hard to put down.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The class discussed why phones were hard to put down.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
